_note: The second masculine face is the first turned about (the other two men on the sheet are mugshots: a frown, a pout, stubble and a moustache are in their colour).
_: Landmarks of the reference faces in tools/refs/snips/face-scans-sheet.png (the user's screenshot of four unwrapped photo-scan face textures, 2026-11-05: 'borrow HEAVILY from this image'). Each face is a crop of the sheet [left, top, width, height] and the places, in the crop's own pixels, of the two eyes' centres, the line of the mouth and the bottom of the chin; `top` is how high up the face (in metres in the head's own frame) the photograph is used before the hair begins. tools/face-scans.mjs makes a colour map of each in the head's face plane (the skin's own colour divided out, so that it serves every skin tone), tools/build-head-textures.mjs lays it on the atlas.
